title: Chern Conjecture on the Euler Characteristic of Closed Affine Manifolds
exact_target: Must a closed positive-dimensional manifold admitting affine coordinate changes have Euler characteristic zero, even without completeness?

sources.citation: Emmanuel Gnandi, Michel Nguiffo Boyom, and Stephane Puechmorel, Canonical foliations of statistical manifolds with statistical models, Remark 2.4.
